title_sq: AMBIENT KOMERCIAL PER SHITJE PRANE RRUGES SE BARRIKADAVE!
description_sq:
Shitet ambient komercial prane Rruges se Barrikadave , ne nje nga zonat me te frekuentuara te Tiranes. 
Ambienti ndodhet ne katin 0 prane rruges kryesore dhe ka nje siperfaqe prej 40 m2. 
E pershtatshme per farmaci, dyqan parfumesh, butik, zyre sherbimi, agjensi turistike apo aktivitet te ngjashem tregtar.
Dyqani ka akses nga rruga kryesore duke e bere nje zgjedhje ideale per biznesin tuaj.
Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone!
title_en: COMMERCIAL ENVIRONMENT FOR SALE NEAR THE ROAD OF BARRICADES!
description_en: Commercial premises for sale near the Barricades Street, in one of the most frequented areas of Tirana. The environment is located on the 0th floor near the main road and has an area of ​​40 m2. Suitable for pharmacy, perfume shop, boutique, service office, tourist agency or similar commercial activity. The store has access from the main road making it an ideal choice for your business.
